payload.label: AI: turn a prompt into items
AI records producer
payload.description: Generic primitive: an AI agent produces structured records from an instruction. Resolves the configured agent from selected-agent (canonical SSOT) falling back to provider-primary, delivers profile instructions through bounded owner hydration or a hash-only system-prompt mount, and invokes the DATA-selected process, process_session, or HTTP transport. Parses the reply into items keyed by output_kind (DATA). The breakdown is one DATA configuration of this seam.

provenance_policy.model_provenance_ref: stamped by the producer from the resolved agent of the run when absent on the item
provenance_policy.confidence: pass-through only; never fabricated; non-numeric values are dropped so threshold consumers fail closed on absence
provenance_policy.evidence_refs: always present as a list (defaults to [])

payload.note: Conforms to ai-execution-history contract — required field is id

payload.label: Breakdown instruction
payload.description: Wrap instruction for the breakdown DATA configuration. The workflow resolves this ref and renders the full instruction text by appending the user's goal.
payload.wrap_prefix: Break this goal into 5-9 concrete, concise action steps. Return ONLY a JSON array of step strings — no prose, no markdown. Goal:

payload.label: Vision board instruction
payload.description: Wrap instruction for the vision-board curate DATA configuration. The workflow resolves this ref and appends the user's dream. One more DATA configuration of the same producer (no code).
payload.wrap_prefix: Turn this dream into a vision board. Return ONLY a JSON array of 6-9 short, vivid, present-tense, first-person statements describing this life as if it is already real (each under 12 words) — no prose, no markdown, no numbering. Dream:

payload.name: write-ai-records-producer-record
payload.description: Write one canonical ai-records-producer record emitted by the command run. Cloned from agent-producer action:write-agent-producer-record-from-command-run.

payload.name: read-ai-records-cli-registry
payload.description: Read the canonical fold-path CLI launch DATA directly through the generic current-record path selector. No current-item mirror or app-specific copy is created.

payload.name: run-ai-records-production
payload.description: Generic AI-records producer. Resolves the configured agent from selected-agent (SSOT); delivers small profile instructions through bounded current-owner hydration or by-set-live selections through a hash-only CAS system-prompt mount; snapshots optional addressed inputs; dispatches through the resolved provider transport; and writes result/error/audit records. The breakdown remains one DATA configuration (wrap_instruction_ref=instr:breakdown, output_kind=note).

input_refs.description: Optional ordered canonical addressed inputs. Each string address, or object with address/canonical_address and optional expected_revision/expected_content_hash, is current-owner-read and snapshotted before provider dispatch.

input_snapshot_limits.description: Optional stricter per-request caps: max_items, max_item_bytes, max_total_bytes. Values may only lower producer-wide hard ceilings.
